method.municipal_question: Which modeled nodes cross 10 m3 of reported overflow under a hypothetical loss of diameter in a source-selected conduit, with independently observed regional rainfall?
method.event_selection: Largest complete local-calendar wet day in August 2018 by observed lower-bound daily rainfall; ties earliest. Require the complete preceding and following day (72 hourly intervals); no missing-to-zero fill.
method.scenario: capacity75: multiply ONE selected source circular conduit diameter by 0.75; retain all other source physics. This is hypothetical effective geometry, not observed blockage or literal sediment depth.
method.target_selection: Largest sum of source subcatchment areas directly assigned to the upstream node, among original positive-length circular conduits; ties conduit ID. No result-based target selection.
method.swmm_time_convention: VOLUME hourly values at interval START in local standard/daylight model clock. DMI climateData explicitly gives from/to. KNMI HH labels interval END in UTC; subtract one hour before timezone conversion. August has no DST transition.
method.inspection: Separate five-minute full-network input for control, hotstart and cancellation tests, never mixed with municipal scenario results.

limitations: Historical published neighborhood models, not full municipal inventories or current condition surveys.

No new calibration or field validation. Original Bellinge models are explicitly uncalibrated; Tuindorp was adapted from InfoWorks and originally simulated with SWMM 5.1.015. This experiment uses 5.2.4.
Hourly observations at regional stations, spatially uniform across all source gauges; local convective extremes and spatial variability are unresolved. No synthetic temporal disaggregation.
A 24-hour warm-up from the original empty initialization is a declared convention, not demonstrated hydrologic/sewer equilibrium.
Preserve original ponding differences. Node overflowing volumes can include water that ponds/re-enters; they are not identical to system flooding loss.
Native report node volume resolution is 1 m3. A displayed zero in a listed flooding row is not proof of no overflow.
Overflow volume is not a 2D flood extent, damage estimate, health/safety judgment, current blockage diagnosis or city ranking.
Native warnings and continuity errors remain reviewable. No quantitative forecast, calibration or final-product qualification is admitted.
